temporary_goal: Survive the promised fire fragment, then determine what the burned ravine and active portal are.
strategy: Open on direct rescue action, cut before the outcome, inspect persistent block evidence and enter when no ordinary destination explains it.
primary_location: Burning cabin fragment, ruined west rim and north-wall portal cave
complications: The region is unvisited, the cabin is deliberately built, the frame is active and no owner or body exists.
reversal: The portal leads to the same pristine ravine before any player construction.
outcome: The protagonist crosses by choice and loses his temporal and geographic certainty.
story_state_afterward: An environmental mystery becomes one-way displacement.
production_note: Keep the cold open under forty seconds; show no silhouette, written message or second avatar.

temporary_goal: Establish a safe life while preserving access to the absent portal site.
strategy: Camp on the west shelf, obtain bones through survival play, tame Moss and expand the shelter through repeatable routines.
primary_location: Pristine ravine, west shelf cabin and nearby spruce terrain
complications: Night pressure, limited supplies and the absent frame make immediate return impossible.
reversal: The efficient cabin footprint begins matching the ruin seen before entry.
outcome: The protagonist gains a home and companion but also creates emotionally costly future evidence.
story_state_afterward: Stranded survival becomes attachment in borrowed time.
production_note: Prioritise real taming, following, feeding, building and sit-release gameplay over montage abstraction.

temporary_goal: Prevent the remembered ruin and leave with Moss safely.
strategy: Match construction details, stone-clad the timber route, pack for departure and neutralise the lava shelf before dawn.
primary_location: Cabin, ravine stair and lava shelf
complications: The portal may require obsidian, night makes immediate travel unsafe and one timber support remains hidden behind the cladding.
reversal: Mining the cooled hazard opens a lateral lava source to the concealed support.
outcome: The protagonist acts on foreknowledge, but the prevention operation becomes the fire’s physical cause.
production_note: Make every matched clue readable in block placement; the fire path remains provisional until tested.

temporary_goal: Reach and release Moss before the fire consumes the sitting place.
strategy: Ignore storage and structural defence, route the single water source towards Moss and break the shortest wall path.
primary_location: Burning stair, cabin main room and bedside sitting place
complications: Fire has entered separated blocks, Moss remains seated and the protagonist begins below the cabin.
reversal: He arrives within interaction range only after the terminal damage interval.
outcome: Moss dies and the burned shell becomes the ruin from the opening.
story_state_afterward: Immediate care becomes grief and full causal recognition.
production_note: The wolf must never appear penned; test the timing and stage the death without invented keepsakes or false mechanical claims.

temporary_goal: Reconstruct and activate the temporal frame before grief gives way to acceptance.
strategy: Trace the burn, use mined obsidian, copy the remembered frame and improvise a lava-and-spruce ignition.
primary_location: Burned cabin route and north-wall portal cave
complications: The safe ignition tools are lost, the protagonist is damaged, rescue water removed a branch torch and a creeper can approach from darkness.
reversal: The creeper kills him, but its blast releases lava to the remaining spruce and allows fire to activate the frame.
outcome: The builder mystery, blast scar and active opening portal receive one tragic causal answer.
story_state_afterward: Failed return becomes the threshold that began the journey.
production_note: No simultaneous double is needed; verify the blast, lava, fire, portal and item-destruction chain before lock.
